Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap to make sure we’re aligned on the costing and next steps. I captured the call notes and a few asks below.

1) High-level product scope you described
- Feature: conversational triage + automated follow-ups (patient messages, appointment reminders) integrated into EHR workflows.
- Target users: care coordinators + clinicians for 3 pilot clinics (~10k monthly MAUs across pilot).

2) Key volume & performance signals
- Estimated active tokens per user interaction: 1.2k tokens (prompt + response average)
- Expected monthly token volume (pilot): 10M–30M tokens (you gave a range; we used 20M as midpoint for examples)
- Target latency: 300–500ms tail for interactive flows

3) Budget & unit economics objective you shared
- Budget range: $8k–$20k/month for pilot inference spend (cap-excl. implementation)
- Business metrics: aim for <= 90 day CAC payback and ~35–45% gross margin at launch (inference variable costs only)

4) What Redwood can provide (quick sketch)
- Pricing bands: per-1M-token pricing that scales with committed monthly volume + burst capacity for spikes
- Model options: Redwood-verified LlamaX small/medium family (quantized) vs larger-context reference model for safety-sensitive responses
- Autoscaling & prefix-KV caching to cut per-token cost for repeat patient prompts

5) Pending items / asks (action items)
- Alex: confirm expected monthly messages per MAU (to firm volume into token projection) — due Wed 5/26
- Priya: send a sanitized example prompt+response (no PHI) so we can run a short tokenization sample — due Wed 5/26
- Jordan / Marissa: circulate a lightweight unit-econ workbook showing $/1M token bands, feature-level $/month estimates, and a 12-month CAC payback scenario — target delivery Tue 5/26

I’m attaching a short pricing bands PDF with initial ranges and will follow up with a filled unit-econ workbook once we get your prompt sample and clarified volumes. If any of the bullets above are off, flag them here and I’ll update.

Next step: 30-minute follow-up to review the workbook + align on pilot commitment. Proposed slots: Thu 5/27 10:00–10:30 PT or Fri 5/28 09:00–09:30 PT. Which works?

Best,
Jordan

Filing in a few practical notes from the commercial side — Jordan flagged next steps but wanted to add concrete ranges we can show Pathwell at the call tomorrow: 

1) Pricing bands — anchored on committed monthly tokens (examples show per-1M-token cost incl. model and infra):
- 5–10M / mo: $950–$1,200 per 1M tokens
- 10–25M / mo: $700–$900 per 1M tokens
- 25–50M / mo: $500–$650 per 1M tokens

2) Feature-level breakout (example monthly cost @ 15M tokens / mo midpoint):
- Conversational triage: ~7.5M tokens (~$5,250 @ $700/1M)
- Automated follow-ups (batches): ~4.5M tokens (~$3,150)
- Summaries & clinician notes: ~3.0M tokens (~$2,100)
- Total inference spend (15M): ~$10,500/month (before any committed discounting)

3) Unit economics & CAC payback framing (simplified):
- If incremental ARR per pilot clinic = $15k/month and pilot brings 3 clinics in year 1 => incremental ARR run-rate $45k/mo
- If Redwood inference cost is $10.5k/mo and other COGS ~ $4k/mo, gross margin on incremental revenue ~ 57%.
- CAC: assume $25k sales + onboarding cost for pilot; at $45k/mo incremental ARR, payback ~ 1.5 months (very optimistic) — but for conservative view assume partial conversion to customers: if only 1 clinic converts initially, payback ~ 6 months.

4) Risks & mitigations
- Token inflation from long prompts: recommend prompt templates and KV caching to reduce repeat token spend.
- Safety token overhead for additional context: propose a safety budget line in the proposal.

I uploaded a skeleton unit-econ workbook for Jordan to fill with Alex’s prompt sample (will attach final labeled workbook in follow-up).

See you on Thu 10:00 PT.

-Marissa
